explication: Optiland is a Python optical-design platform with a GUI. The principal workflow is to construct an optical system, trace rays through it, and analyze its optical performance; engineers can then optimize and tolerance the design. The repository also supports non-sequential tracing, image simulation, file interoperability, and interactive visualization. The graph reflects README capabilities and sampled source; several core call paths and unsampled subsystem wiring are therefore left unspecified.
